what: Volatile alkyl-modified methylsiloxane fluid (INCI Caprylyl Methicone). The non-cyclic D4/D5-free volatile carrier used in sunscreens, serums, primers, hair oils, antiperspirants — the modern replacement for cyclopentasiloxane.
producers: Dow / DOWSIL FZ-3196 · Momentive Silsoft 034 · Shin-Etsu KF-… alkyl series · Elkem Mirasil C-DML · Siltech Silmer / Silwax · BRB Brasil · Jeen Jeesilc
silitex: NOT in the Silitex catalogue (44 SKUs) or the 37 offset categories. Silitex cosmetics line = emulsions/microemulsions, elastomer gels, Volatile D5 / CM 040 (cyclic). Closest Silitex answer: Volatile D5 Fluid / CM 040 (cyclic, REACH-flagged) or EVEROIL 35 / EVERIX 35 (vegetal emollient emulsion) — neither is a drop-in.
history: Sold in volume by Sapirim (Dow Corning era) to Israeli cosmetics producers.
action: Raise with Federica: (1) can Silitex source/private-label an alkyl methicone from a partner, (2) if not — agree Sapirim may keep a second supplier for this one molecule so cosmetics accounts (AHAVA, Peer Pharm, Moroccanoil) get a full basket. Add to the contract 'gaps' annex.
